title: Leather Industry Solutions
description: Comprehensive ERP solutions designed for leather manufacturers, optimizing tannery operations, quality control and production processes while ensuring environmental compliance and material traceability.

infoCards.title: Production Management
infoCards.description: Advanced leather processing and production management system.

infoCards.title: Quality Control
infoCards.description: Comprehensive quality management system for leather processing.

faqData.question: How does the system manage tannery processes?
faqData.answer: Our system provides complete tannery process management including chemical formulations, process scheduling, environmental monitoring and quality control at each stage.

faqData.question: What quality control features are included?
faqData.answer: The system includes comprehensive quality grading, defect tracking, testing protocols, and certification management with detailed reporting for each batch and product.

faqData.question: Can it handle environmental compliance?
faqData.answer: Yes, our solution manages environmental compliance with effluent treatment monitoring, chemical usage tracking and regulatory reporting for environmental standards.
